messages.text: Hey, I bought the monitor stand in three credit-card instalments. I returned it already. Will the instalments complicate my refund?

Three instalments won’t complicate your refund if they belong to one valid payment record: instalments count as a single payment, and the refund goes back to that original payment. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

The policy doesn’t say how the card issuer will handle the instalments afterward. Would you like a staff member to help with that question? (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)
